name: Pinback
label: Touch and Go
lede: Two San Diego roommates named their band after a crewman in a 1974 John Carpenter space comedy, made the first album on a home computer, and kept Pinback going for more than a quarter century.

eras.title: Sgt. Pinback, on a home computer
eras.text: Zach Smith had spent the 1990s in Three Mile Pilot, whose stint with Geffen ended badly. On a break from that band he started recording with his roommate Rob Crow, who already had a pile of projects of his own.

years.src: Wikipedia: Pinback · Wikipedia: Armistead · Wikipedia: Three Mile Pilot
years.h: Zach Smith and Rob Crow start a band in their San Diego place
years.p: [[Armistead Burwell Smith IV|a2bcc3f4-62e5-46d7-862b-a33938f3ffb6]], who goes by Zach, takes a break from Three Mile Pilot; [[Rob Crow|bd55048b-137d-46cf-845d-604a51b5ade1]] comes from Heavy Vegetable. They name the project after Sgt. Pinback, a crewman in John Carpenter's 1974 film Dark Star.
years.xp:
The two had played together as roommates without releasing anything. Smith's bass style, chords and harmonies where most players stay on single notes, came out of "being bored" with plain basslines, he has said.

Three Mile Pilot's Geffen era had ended with the label dropping the band over a long, troubled album, Another Desert, Another Sea, letting them keep the masters. Samples from Dark Star run through Pinback's early records.

years.src: Wikipedia: This Is a Pinback CD · Wikipedia: Armistead
years.h: Minutemen drums and a Shaggs loop on This Is a Pinback CD
years.p: The Ace Fu debut, recorded on Smith's own computer, borrows drums from [[Minutemen|d4ad0149-d8ae-4105-8009-0221fce9ff35]]'s "It's Expected I'm Gone" for a song named "Hurley" and from the Shaggs for "Shag."
years.xp: A European edition on Cutty Shark the same year reshuffled the running order and added two songs, "Versailles" and "Byzantine," later collected on Nautical Antiques. George Hurley was the Minutemen's drummer.

years.src: Wikipedia: Blue Screen Life · Wikipedia: Armistead
years.h: Blue Screen Life on Ace Fu, CD first and vinyl a year later
years.p: The second album, still on Ace Fu, still built by the two of them around Smith's bass, layered parts and drum machines.

eras.title: Touch and Go, and a drummer who stays
eras.text: Touch and Go gave Pinback a bigger stage, and Chris Prescott gave them a steady drummer. The records were still made at home.

years.h: Pinback sign to Touch and Go, and Chris Prescott takes the drums
years.p: The Chicago label signs the band for album three. Prescott joins the same year and becomes the drummer the two founders tour with from then on.

years.src: Wikipedia: Summer in Abaddon · San Diego Reader
years.h: Summer in Abaddon, made in Smith and Crow's home studio
years.p: Their Touch and Go debut. The San Diego Reader reports it had sold about 69,000 copies in the US by mid-2006.

years.src: Wikipedia: Pinback · Wikipedia: This Is a Pinback CD
years.p: A rarities collection gathers B-sides and tracks off the European debut, including "Versailles" and "Byzantine."

years.h: Autumn of the Seraphs, sleeve by a Magic: The Gathering artist
years.p: The second and last Touch and Go album. First pressings came with a bonus disc of three unreleased studio songs, two from the same sessions; Mike Sutfin drew the cover.

years.h: Pinback play live on NPR's Talk of the Nation
years.p: Four weeks after Autumn of the Seraphs, the band does a nationally broadcast interview and plays a couple of songs on the NPR call-in show.

eras.title: Five years to the next record
eras.text: The band lost a friend from the live lineup, left Touch and Go as the label scaled back, and took five years over album five. Shows, though, kept coming.

years.h: Terrin Durfey, keyboards and bass on the road, dies of cancer
years.p: Durfey had been part of Pinback's live band. The San Diego Reader reports he died in late October 2008 after battling cancer.

years.cap: Zach Smith with Pinback at the Depot, November 2009
years.src: Wikipedia: Pinback · Wikipedia: Three Mile Pilot
years.h: Pinback move to Temporary Residence for album five
years.p: The band announces a new record for Temporary Residence Ltd. Three Mile Pilot and [[The Black Heart Procession|fd0f1d5f-5d8c-4fcd-9d3c-0c9f20cddc08]] made the same move after Touch and Go downsized.

years.cap: Rob Crow with Pinback at Berbati's Pan, Portland, July 2011
years.src: San Diego Reader · Wikipedia: Three Mile Pilot
years.h: Two whole albums, start to finish, at the Casbah
years.p: Pinback play two complete albums at San Diego's Casbah, the club where Smith's Three Mile Pilot had played three sold-out 20th-anniversary nights two years earlier.

yt: Pinback, "Proceed to Memory" live on WNYC's Soundcheck
years.h: Information Retrieved, the first album in five years
years.p: "Proceed to Memory" premieres on RollingStone.com; the "Sherman" video is modeled on the 1962 Soviet sci-fi film Planeta Bur. Tours run in two-week legs, because all three members now have kids.
years.xp: Smith told the Badger Herald that breaking the tour into short legs let everyone get home to their families, and that illness is the real enemy on the road: "You just cant get sick on tour, it's not like you can cancel."

years.cap: Pinback at the Fillmore, San Francisco, August 2013
yt: "His Phase" on Late Night with Jimmy Fallon
years.h: Pinback make their late-night TV debut on Jimmy Fallon
years.p: Fifteen years in, the band makes its network late-night debut on Late Night with Jimmy Fallon.

years.cap: Pinback at the Casbah, San Diego, July 2014
years.h: Summer in Abaddon turns ten, and goes back on the road
years.p: The San Diego Reader lists a 10th-anniversary tour for the band's first Touch and Go album.

eras.title: Crow quits, Pinback doesn't
eras.text: Rob Crow announced in 2015 that he was quitting music. Two years later a new Pinback EP came out.

years.h: Rob Crow announces on Twitter that he's done with music
years.p: Crow's tweet said making music in the current climate was "humiliating to my psyche," Stereogum reported two days later. The man behind dozens of projects, from Goblin Cock to Optiganally Yours, was stepping away.

years.cap: Pinback on tour with Savak, October 2017
yt: Live at the Masquerade, Atlanta, September 2017
years.p: Two years after Crow's announcement, a new Pinback EP comes out, the San Diego Reader notes.

eras.title: Abaddon in full, two nights a city
eras.text: Pinback came back as a touring band, leaning on the record that broke them on Touch and Go.

yt: Pinback live at Thalia Hall, Chicago, April 23, 2023 (fan video)
years.h: On the 2023 tour, Crow and Prescott double as the opener's band
years.p: Disheveled Cuss, the solo project of Tera Melos's Nick Reinhart, opens every show, and Crow and Prescott play in his band too, BrooklynVegan reported. Chicago's Thalia Hall set was filmed in full.

years.h: Summer in Abaddon turns 20 with a couple of California shows
years.p: The anniversary gets a short run at home rather than a tour, according to the band's site.

years.h: Philadelphia, Brooklyn, DC: two nights each, one of them all Abaddon
years.p: Crow, Smith and Prescott play Underground Arts, the Music Hall of Williamsburg and Union Stage, with Summer in Abaddon in full on the first night. DC's Hammered Hulls open every show.
